classificationDefinitions.supported/exposed: Implemented execution/read contract and discoverable current UI; source verification does not establish redesign acceptance.
classificationDefinitions.supported/unexposed: Implemented backend capability without corresponding current dashboard control or complete saved-state projection.
classificationDefinitions.partial: Exposed or partly connected capability with a source mismatch, bounded parity gap or unresolved real verification result.
classificationDefinitions.internal-only: Execution mechanism or dormant declaration excluded from user parity with an explicit reason.
classificationDefinitions.unavailable: No underlying source/evidence supports the user-facing claim; require an honest unavailable state.

operator-read.rule: Analytics and quota admin routes require a valid dashboard session or CLI operator token regardless of requireLogin. Inference key alone is insufficient.

operator-loopback-mutation.rule: Operator credential plus loopback peer for state-changing /api/admin methods. 401 anonymous, 403 wrong credential class or remote mutation.

operator-loopback-export.rule: Export is read-only at the database, but its POST method still passes the operator/loopback mutation gate. Do not promise remote export without that current permission.

dashboard-configuration.rule: Non-admin API middleware applies route-specific current dashboard/CLI authentication. requireLogin=false can affect generic reads/configuration paths; /api/settings writes have an extra signed-session/CLI/local-origin precondition. These are not interchangeable with always-protected admin rules.

always-protected-key-configuration.rule: /api/keys and access-profile operations are always protected; do not infer anonymous access from requireLogin=false.

endpoint-specific-session-auth.rule: REST /api/context-status is an operator dashboard projection of retained session statuses under the existing generic dashboard middleware. MCP context_status resolves the relevant session through its bearer-credential contract. These are different projections; no new user-role model is implied.

capacity-economics-v1.boundary: Synthetic-only disposable DATA_DIR, isolated authenticated preview, blocked provider traffic. This inventory did not start or mutate it.

knownVerificationOracle.lastActualResult: Physical point click and keyboard exact-row selection passed; attempted zoom retained 12 rows instead of expected 7. Clear restoration was not reached. Final test-only thumb targeting adjustment has not been browser-tested.
knownVerificationOracle.instruction: Keep pending through redesign. Do not reset expected populations or call the unrun change a pass.
knownVerificationOracle.redesignCandidate: Source placement and drag-update candidate implemented; no new real browser run. Original failed receipt remains authoritative.

crossCuttingBoundaries: Supported user-facing capabilities, including API-only implemented options, form the parity denominator. Internal implementation methods do not each create a new feature.

Accounting uses USD application estimates or explicitly labeled reports. Rates are USD per million tokens. Quota resource units remain separate; historical capture time and observation time are different fields.
usageHistory completion costs, requestStats attempts, costLedger modeled differences and API-key budget reservations overlap in coverage and must not be added as separate spend.
Exact request identity and server completion UUID have different owners and contracts. Client-controlled short rid and timestamps cannot repair missing completion evidence.

Shared URL preserves scope/selection/comparison only. Saved schema-v3 investigations additionally retain explicit Context and Economics state; temporary table/zoom/scenario/observation-mode choices are not implicitly persisted.
No new visual direction is defined here. Destination slots are functional mapping proposals for the lead to compose into the redesign.
